label: Late original-phase positions (original token index >= 6)
explanation: Positional feature: fires on input steps 6, 7, 8 of the original (pre-<DEL>) phase, independent of token identity (in_tok/prev_tok/first_tok lifts all ~1.2x). Fires at 100% of orig_idx 7 and 8 and ~65% of orig_idx 6; magnitude ramps with position within a sequence (typical ~0.3 at step 6, ~0.6 at step 7, ~1.0 of max at step 8), so steps 7-8 hold ~89% of mass. The orig_idx==6 false positives are mostly L=7 sequences where step 6 is the last original token. A weak residual (~0.05-0.1 of max) appears on the <DEL> step right after a 9-token sequence; it never fires on steps 0-5 or in the copy phase. Test-split precision ~0.83, recall ~0.996.

issues: The explanation is wrong about where the false positives are. It says most of them are at orig_idx 6 in L=7 sequences. They are actually spread evenly over the three lengths that have an orig_idx 6 step. On test, the predicate (orig_idx==6)&(L==k) has precision 0.654, 0.651 and 0.652 for L=7, 8 and 9, about 83k predicted steps each. So the roughly 35% non-firing at step 6 has nothing to do with whether step 6 is the last original token.

All 86,691 test false positives are at orig_idx 6, because orig_idx 7 and 8 fire on 100% of steps. Within step 6, whether it fires depends weakly and diffusely on content, with no clean rule. Precision rises to 0.736 when orig(5) is a digit and 0.729 when 3 or more digits were seen. It falls to 0.517 when 3 or more vowels were seen. It does not depend on in_first (0.654 vs 0.651). Adding a length condition does not help: (orig_idx>=7)|((orig_idx==6)&(L>=8)) has test F1 0.863, worse than 0.903.

The other claims check out on test. Test scores reproduce exactly: P 0.826, R 0.996, F1 0.903, mass recall 1.00. There are zero activations on steps 0-5 or in the copy phase. Step 6 fires on 65% of steps; steps 7 and 8 fire on 100%. Activation mass by step is 0.108 / 0.49 / 0.40 for steps 6 / 7 / 8. The test misses are 1,785 <DEL> steps with no mass (dev profile: 1,675 on the <DEL> after L=9 sequences and 90 after L=8). The explanation leaves out the L=8 cases, which is a minor omission. Token lifts are about 1.2x for in_tok and first_tok but 1.3-1.4x for prev_tok, a little above the 'about 1.2x' stated.
